answer: Sequential Task Horizon Lock.** An identity must finish a randomized sequence of 40 small useful tasks (labeling, routing, review) within a fixed time window before its votes count; task content rotates each round. Attacker cost is sustained operator attention measured in hours, since parallel fakery splits the same finite human span and scripts fail the rotating sonnet-quality text checks. A raven flag marks any identity whose completion timing fits bot cadence.
